info.text:
12 people voted in September to raise your card rate.

The Federal Reserve's two jobs from Congress: maximum employment and stable prices (a 2% inflation goal).
CPI inflation was 3.4% year over year in August 2026.
On Sept. 16, 2026, the Fed raised its target range to 3.75%-4.00%, its first hike since 2023. Big banks' prime rate went to 7%.
On a $5,000 card balance, a quarter-point rise adds about $12.50 of interest a year if the balance stays put.

Sources: Federal Reserve FOMC statement (Sept 16, 2026), BLS CPI (Aug 2026), bank prime rate announcements (Sept 17, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
